  timesheet    Show time entry report per working day, grouped by project, task, and client.

result.stdout:
Usage: bulk-add [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Bulk add time entries from a JSON file.

Options:
  --path <string>        Path to JSON file. [Required]
  --day <DateOnly?>      Default day when not specified in the JSON file. Default to today.
  --api-key <string?>    Clockify API key. Fallback to env CLOCKIFY_API_KEY.
  --api-url <string?>    Clockify API URL. Fallback to env CLOCKIFY_API_URL.

result.stdout:
Usage: timesheet [arguments...] [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Show time entry report per working day, grouped by project, task, and client.

Arguments:
  [0] <string>    today, yesterday, this-week, last-week, this-month, last-month. "_" is accepted as well, e.g. this_week.

Options:
  --api-key <string?>       Clockify API key. Fallback to env CLOCKIFY_API_KEY.
  --api-url <string?>       Clockify API URL. Fallback to env CLOCKIFY_API_URL.
  --report-url <string?>    Clockify report API URL, it's hosted separately from API URL. Fallback to env CLOCKIFY_REPORT_URL, then derived from API URL.
